# V2 diagnostic bootstrap provisioning

This document defines the owner commands for the disposable V2-R0 diagnostic
runtime. They do not authorize production rollout, change diagnostic bootstrap
semantics, create learner plans, call Student, Teacher, or AI, or provision
Course content.

## Fail-fast Planner migration image

Build the dedicated target from the exact Planner source context selected for a
run:

```sh
docker build --target migration -f docker/Dockerfile -t planner-v2-migrate:run .
docker run --rm --network <run-network> \
  -e DATABASE_URL='postgres://…' \
  planner-v2-migrate:run
```

The image runs `/app/migrate-up`. It applies only lexically sorted `*.up.sql`
files with `psql ON_ERROR_STOP=1`; the first SQL error returns non-zero and
stops the command. It has no down mode, no fixture, no bootstrap binding, and
no demo-data command.

Planner migration history contains documented Planner-owned target/policy graph
migrations. The JSON receipt reports those as
`historical_catalog_migrations_applied=true`. It also asserts the V2-specific
postcondition that `diagnostic_bootstrap_binding_rows=0` and reports
`fixture_or_binding_seeded=false`.

Example successful receipt:

```json
{"schema":"learning-planner-migration.v1","status":"applied","migration_direction":"up","migration_count":15,"historical_catalog_migrations_applied":true,"fixture_or_binding_seeded":false,"diagnostic_bootstrap_binding_rows":0,"schema_postcondition":"passed"}
```

Failure output is a safe JSON object on stderr with a closed reason code. It
never writes the database URL or credentials.

## Closed V2 bootstrap-binding provisioner

Build and run the dedicated target only after the Course owner provisioner has
returned the canonical Course UUID:

```sh
docker build --target diagnostic-binding-provision -f docker/Dockerfile -t planner-v2-binding-provision:run .
docker run --rm --network <run-network> \
  -e DATABASE_URL='postgres://…' \
  -e PLANNER_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDING_COURSE_ID='<canonical-course-uuid>' \
  -e PLANNER_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDING_CREATED_AT='2026-09-26T12:00:00.123Z' \
  planner-v2-binding-provision:run
```

Inputs are closed to this exact immutable binding:

| Field | Required value |
|---|---|
| `goal_code` | `first-job` |
| `direction_code` | `backend` |
| `binding_revision` | `1` |
| `policy_version` | `diagnostic-bootstrap-v1` |
| `active` | `true` |
| Course ID | Canonical UUID supplied through `PLANNER_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDING_COURSE_ID` |
| Creation time | Caller-supplied canonical UTC microsecond timestamp through `PLANNER_DIAGNOSTIC_BINDING_CREATED_AT` |

The command computes `binding_digest` internally. It locks the binding table
before reading the latest row and inserting. An absent binding returns
`created`; the exact latest binding returns `already_present`; a different
Course, revision, timestamp, active flag, policy, or digest returns
`binding_conflict` with non-zero exit. It never updates or deletes a binding.

Example safe success result:

```json
{"schema":"planner-diagnostic-bootstrap-binding-provision.v1","status":"created","goal_code":"first-job","direction_code":"backend","course_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111","binding_revision":1,"policy_version":"diagnostic-bootstrap-v1","binding_digest":"sha256:<64 lower-case hex characters>","active":true,"created_at":"2026-09-26T12:00:00.123Z"}
```

The exact rerun has the same fields and `status="already_present"`.
